title: Hanasato Minori — Nom Nom Time!〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

meta.Event: At The End of The Unraveled Thread

rows.Line: Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, I believe we're all set for our next stream.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. Why don't we call things here since it seems like a good place to stop?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, before we do!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So... If none of you mind, there's something I wanna ask all of you with regards to our shoot.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Of course we don't mind.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... When Arisa asked me that one question during our shoot...

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: It must be so hard for you, Minori, since you're the only member of the group who has no experience being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh, I even heard from someone that you had a big slip-up during one of your joint streams or something. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: What?! Uhh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Is she talking about that stream we did with Nanamin?! That wasn't in the script. How am I supposed to answer this one...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Whoa, slow down.
You're going off-script again.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But it would be nice to talk a little bit about our joint stream.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: That was actually one of the times we got to tell everyone about how we met Minori and why we wanted to become idols again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, that's right!
So, for those of you who wanna know more, be sure to check out our video archive online♪

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. Our joint show is also up there, so I hope you'll take this opportunity to watch that too.

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: Wait, you turned her question into an ad for your channel?! But a part of me does want to see this show of yours and learn more about how you formed your group...!

rows.Speaker: Marina
rows.Line: No, wait! That's direct marketing! You're not gonna fool us that easily!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: But you sound totally into them now!

rows.Speaker: Group Members
rows.Line: Yeah, why so prickly all of a sudden?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I didn't know what to say, but you were all there to help me out...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I wanna know how I can prevent myself from freezing up again like that in the future...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Don't worry. I know you feel bad, but it's not actually your fault.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah. I mean, none of us expected her to start chucking curveballs at us like that.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: You even took the time to practice answering questions that weren't in the script when you were at home, yes?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But... I...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Hey, cheer up.
There's no point in beating yourself up since it's not gonna change the past.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, you're right.
Sorry, let's start our debrief!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Good. You're smiling again.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Now, back to our discussion...
First, you need to know what you're gonna talk about when you're asked the same question.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right. Try to recall what happened that time and answer using your own words.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay! I'll give it a try!

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: It must be so hard for you, Minori, since you're the only member of the group who has no experience being an idol.

rows.Speaker: Arisa
rows.Line: Oh, I even heard from someone that you had a big slip-up during one of your joint streams or something. Is that true?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
It's okay, Minori.
Take your time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thanks!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (During that stream, I said I can copy dance routines perfectly but put on a terrible demonstration...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I remember being so worried that I wouldn't be able to become an idol like the others...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But that time, they...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I have my answer!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, can you tell us?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yes, I got a little too ahead of myself during that stream, and I didn't demonstrate my ability to copy dance routines even though I said I was good at it...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: However, that was also the moment I learned that I need to be careful not to upset our viewers...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I understand now that if a script calls for some ad-libbing, I need to go in knowing that there's some risk of failure.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: So, I did slip up, but I also learned something important as a result. And I want to grow based on that experience!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Um... How was that?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: It was a wonderful response.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah, you did a good job of expressing how you truly feel. Nice work.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You remembered what I said that time?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Of course I did!
You taught me something really important that day!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, but... I need to learn how to say stuff like this when we're actually shooting, huh?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
Don't worry, Minori.
Nobody does this perfectly on their first attempt.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So, let's just take it one step at a time.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Okay...!
